messages.author: 43bc50bc5bf76d37
messages.subject: geom_crossbar question/problem
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to regain function of the 'crossbar' like it was in the
example here back in August of 2008. This draws the boxplot and places
a small red crossbar at the median just like I want.

> ccl21BOSgplot = qplot(x=factor(ccl21.combo$bos), y = ccl21.combo
> $ccl.21good, data=ccl21.combo, main="CCL21 versus BOS Outcome\nCCL21
> Protective from BOS", xlab="BOS Developed", ylab="BALF CCL21 (pg/mL)
> scaled axis") + geom_boxplot(aes(colour=factor(combo $bos))) +
> geom_jitter() + scale_colour_grey(name="BOS") + stat_summary
> (fun=median, colour="red", geom="crossbar", width=0.3) +
> scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1800,NA))

Attempting to use this now will throws:
Error: geom_crossbar requires the following missing aesthetics: ymin,
ymax

I get around this by providing fun='median_hilow', but then regardless
of the geom I request, I get crossbar and errorbars.

Has something changed in the way of coding this request?

Thanks, Aric
